poems.title: Flashing Lights
poems.note: the road winding down into the Jones Falls valley

set_pieces.name: Falling with headlights off
set_pieces.line: 2 FLASHING LIGHTS · A Falling with headlights off — “I heard a / scream for help”

set_pieces.name: Eyes dilate
set_pieces.line: 2 FLASHING LIGHTS · B Eyes dilate — “an emergency call / while tossing & turning—”

set_pieces.name: Car pulls up
set_pieces.line: 2 FLASHING LIGHTS · C Car pulls up — “Heart break revisits / an old scene.”

set_pieces.name: The ghost child
set_pieces.line: 2 FLASHING LIGHTS · D The ghost child — “the ghost of a dead / & a love-less / seven-year old child”

set_pieces.name: Parents arguing in the car
set_pieces.line: 2 FLASHING LIGHTS · E Parents arguing in the car — “a child is left / home alone”

set_pieces.name: Tambourine through the window
set_pieces.line: 2 FLASHING LIGHTS · F Tambourine through the window — “and no tears”

foundry_refs.desc: Child’s shoes lit by hallway night-light, frozen mid-step.
Velvet drapes glow red from distant streetlights.
Direct thematic match: Trapped man sprinting down orange subway stairs to escape matrimonial stasis.
foundry_refs.line: A truth he could neither alter nor change. What isn't mine, I still can not give.

foundry_refs.desc: Literal visual match: Stepped pyramid of vintage CRT monitors broadcasting ocean water archive in volumetric light beams.
foundry_refs.line: To follow comets to the capital city of our collective consciousness. Resurrecting Atlantis.

foundry_refs.desc: Literal visual match: The POET standing in dim teal bedroom moving toward rain window overlooking black car.
foundry_refs.line: The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away.
